provider: European Facilities for Earthquake Hazard and Risk (EFEHR)
product_name: European Seismic Risk Model 2020 (ESRM20) OpenQuake-engine input files
retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of the public efehr/esrm20 risk-input repository release v1.0. No repository archive, mapping, site-model, OpenQuake configuration or other provider bytes were acquired. Exact consumer artifacts require immutable commit/path identity plus byte count and SHA-256.
intended_use: Versioned public ESRM20 executable/configuration reference inputs that connect separately admitted scientific components for reproducible research and OpenQuake interoperability, including exposure-to-vulnerability mapping and site-model inputs. This source is not itself a substitute for ESHM20 hazard, ESRM20 exposure, ESRM20 vulnerability, observed damage, insured loss, policy terms or production fitness.

licensing.terms_version_or_date: EFEHR earthquake-risk data-access guidance reviewed 2026-08-13; ESRM20 risk-input repository release v1.0
licensing.attribution_requirements: Provide CC BY 4.0 attribution and cite the applicable ESRM20 technical report and source-specific scientific references for any selected input component.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: CC BY 4.0 permits adaptation without a share-alike requirement; attribution, licence reference and indication of changes remain required.
licensing.notes: EFEHR states that scientific data available through risk.EFEHR and its public GitLab are licensed under CC BY 4.0. This metadata admission is intentionally narrower than the source-rights ceiling and does not approve any exact provider byte for Git publication.

redistribution.conditions: Source rights can support redistribution under CC BY 4.0 subject to its conditions. OpenCatastrophe currently approves metadata only; no exact ESRM20 risk-input artifact has been selected, acquired, hashed or approved for Git publication.

privacy.notes: The reviewed source is a public scientific risk-model input/configuration repository, not person-level data, claims, customer portfolios or proprietary insurance terms.

spatial.extent: Europe; exact spatial support and coordinate/reference semantics depend on the selected input file and must be preserved independently

review.notes: Metadata-only engineering approval for the separate ESRM20 v1.0 risk-input repository. Raw/derived promotion remains blocked until exact commit/path/file identity, SHA-256, scientific role, dependencies, semantics and attribution are independently reviewed.
